flows.title: Create an item
steps: In Square Dashboard, go to Items & services (or Items & menus, or Items & inventory) > Items, and click Create item.
In the Item type field, select the type that best describes the item. The fields shown update to match it.
Enter the item's Name, Price and Description, and use the right column for the other attributes the type offers, such as SKU, inventory tracking, images and modifiers.
Choose a Category from the top-left menu, select the applicable locations under Locations and Channels in the right column, and click Save.

flows.title: Export the team roster
steps: In Square Dashboard, go to Staff > Team > Team members. Only the owner of the Square account can export the roster.
Click Export, select which team member information to export, and click Export.
The information downloads as a CSV file named team-members-YYYY-MM-DD.csv.
